D: Three minions travel to 1968 Villain-Con looking for a new evil boss.
P: Serve the snacks when Kevin, Stuart and Bob arrive at Villain-Con.
S: Banana slices tossed with a little honey, baked at 120C for 90 minutes until crisp, mixed with roasted peanuts.
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and fried onions, wrapped in paper.
the minions stealing the Queen's crown in London
Puff pastry strips twisted with cheddar and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until golden as a crown.
M: Cold chicken in a curried mayonnaise with apricot and sultanas, served on rice or soft rolls.
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
W: Bananas split lengthways with three scoops of ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry.
K: Bananas blended with vanilla ice cream and milk, poured into tall glasses.

s.how: Slice 4 bananas thinly and toss with a spoon of honey. Lay on lined trays and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Cool completely, then toss with 200g roasted peanuts. Yellow, crunchy and very popular.

s.note: the minions stealing the Queen's crown in London
s.how: Brush 2 sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg and cover with grated cheddar and parmesan. Cut into thin strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden as a crown.

m.how: Poach 800g chicken breast for 15 minutes, cool and shred. Mix 200g mayonnaise, 100g Greek yoghurt, 2 tsp curry powder, 3 tbsp apricot jam and 50g sultanas, fold through the chicken and serve with 300g cooked rice and salad leaves.

w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Split 4 bananas lengthways into long dishes. Add three scoops of vanilla ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.

d.how: Blend 3 ripe bananas with 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream and 500ml cold milk until thick and smooth. Pour into tall glasses with straws. Banana, banana, banana, and nothing else needed.
